description: Land Title Settlement Department  -  Bambaragammana,  Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420946 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, encumbrances, and location details) in Wariyapola, Kurunegala District. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as defined in Type 4 classification.
